globals.name: sourceDevice
globals.comment:
The source of the sample data.

Represents the peripheral supplying data. Useful for distinguishing
multiple source peripherals using a common device. Is nullable
when no source information is available when providing sample data.

globals.name: sample
globals.signature: var sample: Result<Sample, any Error> { get }
globals.comment: Retrieves the sensor-specific data sample contained in this response.

globals.name: timestamp
globals.comment: Retrieves the timestamp when the sensor sample was written to the data store.

globals.name: stopRecording
startRecording
globals.comment:
Starts recording sensor data.

The reader must be authorized for the sensor for this to succeed.
This starts recording on this device and any paired devices.
If other readers have already started the sensor recording this
reader's interest in recording will be maintained. Other readers in
other apps for the same sensor will not affect the recording status
of this reader.

- Throws: An error if recording cannot be started due to permissions, hardware limitations,
  or other system restrictions

## Example
```swift
do {
    try await reader.startRecording()
} catch {
    print("Failed to start recording: \(error)")
}
```

globals.name: authorizationStatus
globals.comment:
The current authorization status for accessing the sensor data.

This observable property automatically updates when the user changes sensor permissions
in system settings, allowing to react to authorization changes in real-time.

- Returns: Current `SRAuthorizationStatus` indicating whether the app has permission
  to access the sensor data.
